title: Switching the target integration is a configuration change that takes effect on next boot
asA: operator moving a service from one supervising system to another
iWant: the shift to be a change to the profile name and its options and nothing else
soThat: the migration cost is bounded and the source tree stays free of per-supervisor conditionals

acceptanceCriteria.description: A running service on the `kubernetes` profile, reconfigured to `probeInterface.profile: loadBalancer` and restarted, binds a single `/health` handler with the `singleHealthSignal` semantic model without changes to the source tree.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process booted on `kubernetes` default, and the same source tree with only `probeInterface.profile` changed to `loadBalancer` in configuration
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process restarts on the new configuration and the topology binds
acceptanceCriteria.then: a GET against `/health` returns 200 or 503; no probe handler is bound at `/live` or `/ready`; a source-tree diff between the two boots contains no non-configuration changes

acceptanceCriteria.description: A profile switch that requires a new custom profile is authored against the profile contract and filed under `profiles/custom/<name>` in the project; the switch is then a configuration change to `probeInterface.profile: custom:<name>`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project that authored a `custom:tcpOnly` profile against the profile contract at `profiles/custom/tcpOnly.js` (or equivalent)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator sets `probeInterface.profile: custom:tcpOnly` in configuration and the process restarts
acceptanceCriteria.then: the resolver loads the custom profile, the topology binds the profile's declared surface, and no additional source-tree change is required to move between the shipped set and the custom profile

acceptanceCriteria.description: The profile-resolver call site is a single import point in the process boot path; the source-tree scan finds no per-profile conditional outside the profile modules and the resolver itself.
acceptanceCriteria.when: a scan searches for `probeInterface.profile` usage and per-profile branching (e.g., `if (profile === 'kubernetes')`) outside the `profiles/` directory and the profile-resolver module
acceptanceCriteria.then: the scan finds exactly one usage of `probeInterface.profile` (the resolver invocation) and zero per-profile conditionals in the rest of the boot path
